sentences.text: 1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is accordingly disposed of.

3. The present application under Section 439 read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks regular bail in case FIR No. 225/2022 under Sections 420/448/467/471/120B of the IPC, registered at P.S.
Shahbad Dairy.
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to file a status report.

Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing, with an advance copy to learned counsel for the applicant.
6. List on 08.07.2024 before Roster Bench.
